description: App symbol -> Yahoo Finance (yfinance) symbol, used by scripts/build_replay_dataset.py to build the replay snapshot and by lib/replay to read it. A tradable symbol not listed in 'map' is used as is (Canadian listings such as RY.TO, RCI-B.TO and BIP-UN.TO are already written the Yahoo way in data/universe.json).

replayClass._note: Replay asset class where it cannot be read from data/universe.json (stock -> equity, etf -> etf_equity, crypto -> crypto). Bond and gold funds are told apart here.
